odd_class_divisibility: w_class1 and w_class3 are divisible by8 for every coefficient vector.
proof: Bent amplitudes at1111 and7777 force their count difference to be divisible by16. Each class count is divisible by8, so their sum is divisible by16. W0-Wones=65536-64*(their sum) is then divisible by1024; two values in {+256,-256} can have such a difference only if equal. This forces the sum to1024. The first difference restricts the pair to the three displayed possibilities.
scope: Necessary structural statement for H(16,4), not a nonexistence proof or a claim of bibliographic novelty.
